notes.title: Improved Local Co-Op Option, Chinese language Fixes & Discord QR Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]What’s new:
[/b][/h2][p]• Added a checkbox in the settings to enable local multiplayer using Keyboard/Mouse + Controller → (See image below for updated controls) 
• Fixed an issue where Chinese characters would disappear 
• Updated default settings to launch the game in 120 FPS & high quality 
• Fixed the QR code not appearing in the main menu → Now links directly to our Discord server upon clicking.
• Small collision bug fixes
[/p][p][i]Thanks again for playing Wires and Whiskers and for all your feedback! [/i]ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Wires and Whiskers is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Wires and Whiskers is officially out! 🐭⚡[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]▶️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3874440/Wires_And_Whiskers"]\[Play now][/url]

In this fast-paced 2-player local co-op game, one of you plays a cyber lab gerbil and the other, its armed exosuit. You’ll have to coordinate movement, attacks, and magnetic powers to survive an irradiated world of hostile machines.[/p][p]
[/p][p]- Couch co-op or [b]Steam Remote Play Togethe[/b]r support[/p][p]- Dynamic mix of [b]2.5D navigation and top-down combat[/b][/p][p]- Two unique roles: [b]agile melee[/b] vs. [b]ranged magnetic powers[/b][/p][p]- Mutant enemies, tight puzzles, and smart coordination[/p][p]- Playable in ~30 minutes — ideal for a quick, tactical session!

🎮 [b]Controller Required:[/b] One player must use a controller, the other can use [b]keyboard & mouse[/b] (or  preferably another controller). Keyboard-only support is possible for the gerbil character only, but not recommended.  


💬 [b]Feedback or bugs?[/b]   Scan the [b]QR code in the main menu[/b] or [b] [/b][url="https://discord.gg/EWXjvBXqYz" buttoncolor="#6cb0fe"]join our discord[/url][b] [/b]Link : ([url="https://discord.gg/EWXjvBXqYz"]https://discord.gg/EWXjvBXqYz[/url][b])![/b] [/p][p][/p]

- Mutant enemies, tight puzzles, and smart coordination
- Playable in ~30 minutes — ideal for a quick, tactical session!

notes.title: Checkpoint & Respawn System Fix
notes.content: [h2][b]We've fixed a critical issue affecting progression![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b] What’s fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resolved a bug where players would [b]respawn at the wrong location[/b] after dying or reloading a checkpoint[/p][/*][*][p]Save and checkpoint logic has been fully reworked to ensure consistent and fair placement[/p][/*][*][p]This should prevent frustrating restarts and let you get back into the action smoothly![/p][/*][*][p]Let us know on Discord if you notice anything odd still happening after respawning.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

tags.bug: Resolved a bug where players would [b]respawn at the wrong location[/b] after dying or reloading a checkpoint
Save and checkpoint logic has been fully reworked to ensure consistent and fair placement

notes.title: Update – Localization Support, Checkpoint Saves
notes.content: [h1][b]We’ve released a small update to improve usability and accessibility![/b][/h1][p]---[/p][h3] 🈯 Localization Menu[/h3][p]- Players can now switch between supported languages[/p][p]- Language changes apply immediately without restart[/p][p][/p][h3]💾 Checkpoint Saves (New)[/h3][p]- Game now saves progress at key checkpoints[/p][p]- If you quit or fail, you’ll restart from your last checkpoint[/p][p]- Helps streamline retry flow without losing full progress[/p][p][/p][h3]🔧 Other Tweaks[/h3][p]- Minor improvements to settings UI[/p][p]- Small performance optimizations[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]Let us know on Discord if you notice any bugs or have feedback about the new systems![/i][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: - Players can now switch between supported languages
- Language changes apply immediately without restart
- Game now saves progress at key checkpoints
- If you quit or fail, you’ll restart from your last checkpoint
- Helps streamline retry flow without losing full progress

notes.title: Minor Update – QR Menu, Remote Play Improvements, A/D Support
notes.content: [p][i]We’ve pushed a small update based on your feedback![/i][/p][h2][/h2][h3][b]What’s new:[/b][/h3][p]- Added a **QR code** on the main menu for quick Discord access[/p][p]- Improved **Steam Remote Play Together** support (more reliable controller detection)[/p][p]- You can now use **A/D keys** to switch characters on the selection screen (for keyboard users)[/p][p][/p][p][i][u]Note:[/u] Keyboard play is still designed around a single player using **mouse + keyboard**, but A/D now gives you more flexibility if you still want to use only the keyboard.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes & Optimizations:[/b][/h3][p]- Fixed various minor bugs[/p][p]- Optimized main menu performance[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: - Added a **QR code** on the main menu for quick Discord access
- Improved **Steam Remote Play Together** support (more reliable controller detection)
- You can now use **A/D keys** to switch characters on the selection screen (for keyboard users)
